no_saved_data: No saved data found. Please login again.
logout_confirm: Are you sure you want to log out?
session_loading_hint: This may take a few seconds
profile_source_changed_warning: ⚠ Your IPTV source has changed. Your TV favorites, pinned categories and playback progress have been reset.
profile_error_network: Unable to load profiles. Check your connection.
provider_change_message: The server address does not match the one used so far on your Nyx account. If you continue, your playback progress, TV favorites, pinned or hidden categories and player preferences will be deleted on this device and on all your devices. My List is kept. If it is the same provider, choose Cancel and check the address.
provider_change_cancelled: Change cancelled: nothing was deleted. The server address does not match the one used so far on your account: check it, or confirm the change if it really is another provider.
provider_changed_remote: Your provider was changed from another device. Reconnection required.
local_db_damaged_error: The data stored on this device is damaged: sign-in cannot complete. Your credentials are not the problem.
local_db_damaged_message: The data stored on this device is damaged and can no longer be read. You can reset it: My List, your playback progress and TV favorites are saved in your Nyx account and will come back after you sign in again.
local_db_reset_title: Reset the data on this device?
local_db_reset_confirm: The data on this device (catalog, settings, provider credentials) will be erased and the app will restart. Your Nyx account and what it saves (My List, playback progress, TV favorites) are not affected. You will need to enter your provider credentials again.
local_db_reset_failed: The reset did not complete. Close the app and try again.
update_error_download: The update could not be downloaded or installed. Try again; if the problem persists, download it from the Nyx website.
update_error_check: Cannot check for updates right now. Check your Internet connection.
update_android_permission: Allow Nyx Player to install apps, come back to the app, then press Install again.
update_android_manual: You can also install the update from this address: {{url}}
update_android_error_network: The update could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection.
update_android_error_checksum: The downloaded file is incomplete or damaged: it was not installed.
update_android_error_package: The downloaded file is not Nyx Player: it was not installed.
update_android_error_signature: This update is not signed like the installed app (test build?): it was not installed.
update_android_error_version: The downloaded file does not match the version offered, or is not newer than the installed app.
update_android_error_storage: Not enough space on the device to download the update.
update_android_error_missing: The update file is gone. Please try again.
update_android_error_install: The Android installer could not be opened.
error_boundary_subtitle: This section ran into a problem. The rest of the app keeps working.
progress_reset_failed: Progress could not be reset. Please try again.
watchlist_update_failed: My List could not be updated. Please try again.

tvlink_connected_account_provider: Signed in with your phone · account {{email}} · provider {{host}}
link_fallback_title: This link can't be opened here
link_fallback_message: Open this address on a phone or a computer: {{url}}
guest_leave_confirm: Go back to the welcome screen? Your data stays on this device: you will find it again by choosing “Continue without an account”.
